ip.description: IP address to analyze (IPv4 or IPv6 format). Examples: '8.8.8.8' (Google DNS), '2001:4860:4860::8888' (Google IPv6 DNS), '1.1.1.1' (Cloudflare DNS). Returns geolocation, ASN ownership, BGP prefix, and RPKI validation status - essential for security analysis, geoblocking, network forensics, and traffic analytics.
